about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (packages/item-record): each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths only. A file named .held is the same bytes with its test name taken off so the repository test does not run it; the reason is under `held`. `not_carried` names package files that were left in the package and why.

held.tools/item-record/do-work/read-item-reco: imports @bitfield/runtime-kit or @bitfield/slot-protocol (the retired package runtime); needs the records door in its place
held.tools/item-record/show/ItemFeed.empty-st: a JSX test: it needs a DOM test runtime and the shared ui parts (@/packages/ui) that live in apps parts/ui; not run here
held.tools/item-record/tests/item-record-comp: bundles a package source that imports retired package paths
held.tools/item-record/tests/item-record-crea: reads the package boundary file things-to-store-and-run.json (or the package's own data path), which is not carried
held.tools/item-record/tests/item-record-surf: reads the package boundary file things-to-store-and-run.json (or the package's own data path), which is not carried
